question: P is 20 percent more than Q. Q is how much percentage less than P?
solution:
**Given:**

P is 20% more th
an Q

**Concept:**

{}X\%={Xover100}

**Calculation:**

According to the question

⇒ P = ({1+{20over100}})times Q={120over100}times Q= {6over5}times Q

Q is what percentage less than P

⇒ {P-Qover P}times 100

⇒ {{6Qover5}-Qover {6Qover5}}times 100

⇒ {{6Q-5Qover5}over {6Qover5}}times 100

⇒ {{1over5}over {6over5}}times 100={1over6}times 100=16.66\%

**∴ The required result will be 16.66%**
